Coast Guard aid discrepancies · selected passage

Reports with an explicit temporary replacement are hidden by default when no additional problem is reported. This does not mean the original aid is restored or the replacement was independently verified. Aid discrepancies are available regardless of age. Categories count each aid once at its highest-priority reported problem. A missing or damaged aid with an unreported correction status is uncertain, not confirmed still defective.

Notices are matched by geographic area and effective dates, not interpreted into automatic bridge delays. Read each notice for hours, restrictions and instructions. The notice view applies its age filter to other Coast Guard notices. Aid discrepancies use the category filters above and are retained regardless of age. Bridge delays · live what-if
Bridge delay settings

Red and yellow areas in the supplied map are approximated as slow; default 5.2 knots is about 6 mph. Other areas use your cruising speed. Bridge approaches are assumed slow for 100 yards on each side. Image boundaries are approximate; signs and local rules may differ.

Clearances use nearby tide estimates, not bridge gauges. Advance notice must be arranged. Confirm temporary restrictions.

Loading route…

Preliminary: estimated timing; tide station and shoal locations require verification. No claim of navigable depth.

Predictions & assumptions

Route is a user-supplied planned route, not a recorded passage. Slow sections are approximated from a supplied image and bridge approaches; boundaries and actual rules need verification. Unmarked sections use the selected cruise speed for planning, not a determination of legal speed limits. Slow zones, bridge inventory, clearance and local station assignments are incomplete. NOAA predictions are queried directly for nearby stations and interpolated between six-minute values; nearest station assignments are provisional. Tide heights are not water depths. Conditions can differ from predictions.
